# Frames for the `runtime-dispatch` and `widened-return` rules, typed over `Vector{Any}` arguments.
@noinline dispatching_control(values::AbstractVector{T}) where {T} = (first(values) + 1)::T
function invoking_control(values::AbstractVector{T})::T where {T}
    return dispatching_control(values)
end
function line_exempt(values)
    head = first(values) + 1 # lint: runtime-dispatch  the statement's own opt-out
    return head * 2
end
function exempt(values) # lint: runtime-dispatch  the method's opt-out covers its body
    return first(values) + 1
end
function widened_exempt(values) # lint: widened-return  returns what it is given
    return first(values)
end
function opted_local(values) # lint: abstract-local  the method's opt-out covers its locals
    head = first(values)
    return head === nothing
end
small_union(flag::Bool) = flag ? 1 : 1.0f0
splatted(values) = tuple(values...)
